g.text: ×: no observations; open circle: nonzero but locally sparse
Available effective weighted hours by local time
Bands are conditional pointwise 95% intervals; no simultaneous-band or curve-wide inferential claim is made.
Sites are averaged equally on the fitted log-mean scale; participant and participant-day smooths are excluded from displayed curves.
Panel B divides each displayed activity curve by the displayed global time-of-day mean; the dashed reference is 1. Other is display-only.
The activity palette is distinct from the light-source category colours used elsewhere in this report series.
Each multi-select participant-hour contributes 1/k to every retained activity. Filled circles mark observed support; open circles mark locally sparse support.
Grey regions and × mark zero observations. Only the global smooth is cyclic; thin-plate activity and site deviations may separate over midnight.
No line is wrapped from 24:00 to 00:00. The melEDI axis transformation is display-only.
